SpiritLevel.title: Spirit Level
SpiritLevel.description: Center the bubble inside the ring to level the device.
instructions: Place your device on the surface you want to measure.
Adjust it until the blue bubble sits in the center.
When the bubble is centered, the surface is level.

VelogStat.title: Velog Stat Probe
VelogStat.description: Send a request for a Velog username and inspect which cookies actually arrive at this service.
VelogStat.helper: This test can only see cookies sent to our own origin. It is meant to verify whether Velog cookies are forwarded automatically.
VelogStat.cookieNames: Cookie names received by our origin
